device.description: 16-bit 250 kSPS micro-power SAR ADC with SPI-compatible serial interface and daisy-chain
device.note: ads8339.pdf (SBAS677A) p.3 pin configuration and functions, p.4 recommended operating conditions (+VBD 2.375-5.5 V), p.7 timing requirements, p.18 Table 1 output codes (straight binary), p.18-19 3-wire CS mode (Figure 47), p.20-23 4-wire CS and daisy-chain modes

pages: p.3 (pins), p.4 (ROC), p.7 (timing requirements: tcnv 3300 ns max, t3, ten, tdis), p.18 (Table 1 output codes), p.18-19 (3-wire CS mode, Figure 47), p.20-23 (4-wire CS, daisy-chain)
notModeled: analog input and reference (the 0 V code is 0000h)
mode selection by the SDI level at the CONVST rising edge: only 3-wire CS mode without a busy indicator (SDI high, CONVST as CS) is modeled; SDI is not read
4-wire CS mode (SDI as CS), the busy indicator (CONVST or SDI low at the end of conversion: SDO goes low, an extra SCLK), daisy-chain mode (SDI low at CONVST rise, SDI as chain input)
CONVST must return high before tcnv_min in 3-wire mode; reading before the conversion ends is not checked (the frame shows the constant 0 V code)
conversion time 500-3300 ns (modeled: tcnv max 3300 ns); acquisition time, cycle time and power-down between conversions
timing values are the 2.375-4.5 V +VBD maximums (t3 24 ns, ten 22 ns, tdis 15 ns); 16 / 15 / 12 ns at 4.5-5.5 V
SPI mode: data launch on SCLK falling edges and are valid until the next falling edge (t2 5 ns hold); the host may sample on the rising edge (mode 0, as modeled) or the next falling edge
